title: krypton-umbrella values
description: Validates the umbrella's own keys, most importantly the global block. The krypton-* blocks are left permissive here on purpose: Helm coalesces them into each subchart's values, where the subchart's own (strict) values.schema.json rejects unknown keys.

laneName.description: Lane/environment name; part of every resource name: <subchart>-<lane>-<component-shortname>.

labelDomain.description: Domain prefix for generated label/annotation keys; defaults to krypton.io.

imageRegistry.description: When set, overrides every subchart's image.registry (per-lane proxy/air-gapped registries). Empty disables the override.

labels.description: Static labels stamped onto every resource; values must be strings.

annotations.description: Static annotations stamped onto every resource; values must be strings.

krypton-lib.description: Injected by Helm for the declared library dependency; carries no values.

componentType.description: Component-type key. Membership in the platform catalog is enforced at render time by krypton-lib.componentCatalog (see krypton-lib/templates/_helpers.tpl); the schema only checks the shape.
